lead: A reference card may not cite a rule, and the doc comment two lines above it must.
body: `registry::tests::no_registry_card_cites_an_adr` refuses a citation in any `MethodDoc` `short`/`ret`/`desc`, `ParamDoc`, `ErrorDoc`, `CoreConst::desc` or `EnumDoc` case, because `nvs meta --json` ships the card verbatim to a reader with no rules tree, and it surfaces only at `-p nvs-stdlib --lib`. State the fact in the card and leave the citation in the `///` beside it.
